# ===================================================================
# GOOD VARIABLE EXAMPLES
# ===================================================================
# This file demonstrates CORRECT CK3 variable usage patterns.
# All examples in this file should PASS validation with NO errors.
#
# What this tests:
# - set_variable + has_variable (standard pattern)
# - Local variables (set_local_variable + has_local_variable)
# - Global variables (set_global_variable + has_global_variable)
# - Variable arithmetic (change_variable, add_to_variable, etc.)
# - Variable lists (add_to_variable_list + any_in_list)
#
# Expected validation result: NO ERRORS
# ===================================================================

namespace = variables_good

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 1: Standard variable — set and check
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Basic set_variable + has_variable pattern
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - variable declared before use
# DEMONSTRATES: Correct variable lifecycle
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
variables_good.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = variables_good.0001.t
	desc = variables_good.0001.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = quest_started
			value = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = variables_good.0001.a
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = quest_started
			}
			add_prestige = 50
		}
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 2: Local variables within a single event
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: set_local_variable + has_local_variable
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - local scope used consistently
# DEMONSTRATES: Proper local variable usage
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
variables_good.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = variables_good.0002.t
	desc = variables_good.0002.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		set_local_variable = {
			name = temp_count
			value = 0
		}
		change_local_variable = {
			name = temp_count
			add = 1
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = variables_good.0002.a
		trigger = {
			has_local_variable = temp_count
		}
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 3: Global variable pattern
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: set_global_variable + has_global_variable
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - global scope used consistently
# DEMONSTRATES: Cross-event global variable tracking
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
variables_good.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = variables_good.0003.t
	desc = variables_good.0003.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		set_global_variable = {
			name = world_event_happened
			value = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = variables_good.0003.a
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = world_event_happened
		}
		add_prestige = 100
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 4: Variable arithmetic
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: change_variable, add_to_variable, subtract, multiply, divide
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - variable declared before arithmetic operations
# DEMONSTRATES: Full variable arithmetic lifecycle
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
variables_good.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	title = variables_good.0004.t
	desc = variables_good.0004.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = battle_score
			value = 10
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = battle_score
			add = 5
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			name = battle_score
			value = 3
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			name = battle_score
			value = 2
		}
		multiply_variable = {
			name = battle_score
			value = 2
		}
		divide_variable = {
			name = battle_score
			value = 4
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = variables_good.0004.a
		trigger = {
			has_variable = battle_score
		}
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 5: Variable as list
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: add_to_variable_list + any_in_list
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - list variable used consistently as a list
# DEMONSTRATES: Variable list pattern
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
variables_good.0005 = {
	type = character_event
	title = variables_good.0005.t
	desc = variables_good.0005.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		add_to_variable_list = {
			name = allies_list
			value = root
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = variables_good.0005.a
		trigger = {
			any_in_list = {
				variable = allies_list
				is_adult = yes
			}
		}
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}
